instruction: A candid family portrait in a medium close-up captures a warm moment in a grassy park with autumn trees. In the center, the man in the white hoodie (R2) holds the baby girl in denim overalls (R1) close to his chest, looking down at her with a gentle smile. The baby girl (R1), wearing a pink fleece jacket, looks forward with a curious expression. The man (R2) cradles the baby securely in his arms while the woman (R3) leans in close to his side. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the scene, enhancing the warm palette.
